title: Compatibility of normalized representative tensor models
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme W. Let S,T be coefficient derived system calculi [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data] and C,D be K-flat complexes of modules over the coefficient sequence ring. The canonical transpose-preserving closed-tensor comparison from T to S [lem-coef-closed-tensor-comparison], followed by the inverse representative tensor model for S, equals the inverse representative tensor model for T. No termwise flatness, boundedness or residue-characteristic assumption is needed.

source.place: Tags 0A90, 0A95 and 08J9; the representative tensor/closed comparison part of step 4 of stage3-pur-scalar-tensor-model-normalization.

proof.text: Curry the identity of the ordinary total tensor. Apply coefficientTensorCurry_normalize in both closed structures: after mapping the identity and cancelling it, the two inverse representative tensor models are the uncurrying of the same derived Hom map.

Apply the tensor-Hom transpose for T to the desired equation. The canonical closed comparison preserves the transpose. The inverse laws of the two Hom bijections and the preceding common uncurrying identify the two sides. Injectivity of transpose proves the equality.

theorem coefficientTensorModelComparison (W : Scheme.{u})
    (S T : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E W)
    (C D : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules.{u, u} l E W) ℤ)
    (hC : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (R := coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf.{u, u} l E W) C)
    (hD : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (R := coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf.{u, u} l E W) D) :
    (CoefficientClosedStructure.comparison T.systemClosed S.systemClosed).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C, DerivedCategory.Q.obj D) ≫
      (CoefficientTensorModels.iso.{u, u + 1, u, u + 2}
        (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology W))
        (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf.{u, u} l E W)
        S.systemClosed S.systemTensorModel C D hC hD).inv =
        (CoefficientTensorModels.iso.{u, u + 1, u, u + 2}
        (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology W))
        (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf.{u, u} l E W)
        T.systemClosed T.systemTensorModel C D hC hD).inv
